stages.scope: Deterministic fixture simulation, topology, contracts, registry, safety and garbage-filter tests; zero external actions.
Bounded public-source shadow run with real source URLs, transcript extraction, model outputs, costs, source-health telemetry, independent QA, and no delivery.
Controlled owner-visible delivery rehearsal to one verified recipient and one channel under fresh authority; rollback and failure rehearsal required.
Controlled Live promotion only after measured accuracy, false-alert rate, cost, source coverage, Run009/Run008 handoffs, incident ownership, and backup/restore evidence pass.
